core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fouad corresponds to the Arabic form فؤاد (Arabic root ف أ د (f-ʾ-d)). Its core sense is heart. Fouad (فؤاد, fuʾād) is an Arabic male name meaning 'heart, the innermost heart' — often rendered 'heart, mind, inner self'. The source gloss 'river' is wrong (that is Furat, فرات) and has been replaced.
